plan.failureSummary: The chatbot backend at https://briefcase.chat/api/chat is returning HTTP 500 Internal Server Error on user message submissions, causing assistant responses to render as empty avatar placeholders.
observedIndicators: Browser network logs capture 4 failed requests to https://briefcase.chat/api/chat with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error status.
The live failure screenshot and page text analysis show empty assistant responses (only the 'A' avatar icon rendered) after user queries.
page.ai returned status FAIL with issues describing the chatbot backend's inability to generate responses.
The test runs with cache: false, ruling out stale cached automation instructions.

remediationSteps.summary: Fix backend 500 errors on /api/chat in briefcase.chat
remediationSteps.details: Investigate and resolve the server-side failure in the https://briefcase.chat/api/chat endpoint returning 500 errors when processing chat completions.

plan.notes: The test runs page.ai (with caching disabled) to evaluate chatbot compliance. During evaluation, multiple user queries resulted in HTTP 500 errors on POST /api/chat, preventing the chatbot from returning any text response. Consequently, page.ai reported a FAIL status with details on the backend failure, causing the test assertion (expecting PASS) to fail.
